title: Bayoglu 2017a: fascicle length optimal of transversus abdominis at whole (M, cadaver)

imaging.modality: dissection + laser diffraction + optical tracking of attachments

quantity.name: fascicle_length_optimal
quantity.definition: fibre length normalised to optimal sarcomere length (state value used)

source.authors: Bayoglu R, Geeraedts L, Groenen KHJ, Verdonschot N, Koopman B, Homminga J
source.sample: 1 embalmed cadaver; one embalmed male cadaver, 79 y, 154 cm, 51 kg (Alzheimer; L5 fused to sacrum); one body side; same cadaver for lumbar (2017a) and thoracic/cervical (2017b) datasets

how_to_simulate: Take the model transversus abdominis element(s) named in the data (optimal fibre length / tendon slack length / MTU length in neutral posture).
Compare raw fascicle length with model fibre length in the specimen posture, and sarcomere-normalised length with model optimal fibre length.
